description: Successful redirect-target resolution variants. Selecting the SECOND of a multi-target client's registrations redirects to exactly that target. Under a relaxed (non-exact) policy, a sub-path of a single-target client's registered host is accepted and the chosen sub-path is preserved. Supplying the full registered composite URI of the 'parts' client under explicit exact-match also succeeds with all components preserved.
